pages.text: Put a Tempered Ingot ★ back in the furnace and it comes out aiming one star higher. Each pass is riskier: more strikes, a narrower sweet spot.$(br2)Your forge's level and your Forging skill both cap how high you can go:$(li)★2 at Forging 3, ★3 at 6, ★4 at 10$(li)★5 at 15, ★6 at 20, ★7 at 25
